critical_code_review_comments: Positive: hostname gate is implemented correctly (endsWith with leading dot) and does not fall to any of the tested attack strings (evil-emergent.sh.attacker.com, myemergent.sh).
Positive: dynamic script insertion is inside try/catch, so even if window/location is unusual, the app boot won't be blocked.

Minor: index.html hides the badge purely with `display:none` at the bottom of <body> — the badge briefly renders before the script executes on slow devices (flash of Emergent-badge). Could be pre-hidden via inline `style='display:none'` and un-hidden only when flag is true. Not blocking.

Minor: PostHog stub (`window.posthog = e` and array init) still executes globally BEFORE the isEmergent guard because the IIFE assigns e/window.posthog inside the outer `!(function(t,e){})` call. Re-reading current code: the entire `!(function... )(document, window.posthog || [])` invocation is wrapped inside the `if (window.__RELAYLAB_IS_EMERGENT__) { ... }` block, so the stub is NOT created on self-hosted — good.
Minor (pre-existing, non-blocking): routes.py > 700 lines; yarn.lock committed contradicting Dockerfile comment. Both flagged in iteration_11.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is client-side only (index.html). All 4 inline scripts and hostname gate verified. Backend behavior unchanged from iteration_11 (COOKIE_SECURE env-gated, default false). If user still reports the bug on http://relaylab-production, ask them to (1) hard-refresh browser after `docker compose up -d --build`, (2) fully clear cookies for that origin, and (3) confirm the injected emergent-main.js is NOT present in Network tab (should return zero requests to assets.emergent.sh). If it IS present, the served index.html is stale and Nginx needs rebuild — this is a deploy-cache issue, not a code issue.
rca of the issue: Root cause: assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js (loaded unconditionally from index.html) monkey-patches XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send for platform telemetry. Its patch does not preserve `xhr.withCredentials=true` semantics on non-Emergent origins, so the browser stops sending the rl_session cookie on subsequent API requests, and every authenticated endpoint returns 401 {"detail":"Belum login"} — even though the cookie is set correctly and COOKIE_SECURE is properly false. Fix: gate the entire Emergent-telemetry stack (emergent-main.js script tag, PostHog init, and 'Made with Emergent' badge) behind a hostname check that is TRUE only for exact/subdomain matches of emergent.sh and emergentagent.com. Verification path: (a) preview URL still loads the script and works (Emergent side unaffected), (b) any custom hostname (relaylab-production, LAN IP, localhost, Docker host) will see the flag=false and never load emergent-main.js, so XHR remains unpatched and cookies flow normally. This is a client-only change; backend was already correct after iteration_11.
